title: Finite modulated lattice-comb decompositions for crystalline measures
abstract: In every positive dimension, a crystalline measure with uniformly discrete support and uniformly discrete spectrum is a finite complex linear combination of translated, modulated combs on full-rank lattices. The support and spectrum each lie in finitely many lattice translates. The lattices can differ between terms, and the nonzero atomic weights can approach zero. This gives the physical-support covering conclusion in the question of Lev and Olevskii.
